entries.declaration: Problem: the server plugin needs Node 24.21.0 or later (Mission and Capability Map, D-H row), but its package.json does not declare it; the D-H row records this as not done. Evidence: tools/server-plugin/shardwright-memory/package.json has no engines field; D-H row says "Not done here: declaring engines.node in the plugin's package.json". Target result: package.json declares "engines": { "node": ">=24.21.0" }; payload-manifest.json is regenerated so it carries the new package.json hash (run: node tools/server-plugin/package-shardwright-memory.mjs from the repository root; it must change no file other than payload-manifest.json); the D-H row no longer lists engines.node as not done and records that it is declared. In scope: exactly the three inScopePaths. Out of scope: every other file, including package-lock.json (do not run npm), lib/, the SillyBunny/Bun requirement, any startup error for older Node, AGENTS.md, docs/contracts/, docs/proposals/, tools/slice-runner/, tools/pilot/, vendor/. Outside this repository: nothing. Proof: node tools/pilot/proofs/pilot-1-engines-node.mjs from the repository root (asserts engines.node and the manifest hash, then runs the packaging suite). Stop condition: proof passes; report and stop. Do not commit.

entries.declaration: Problem: nothing tests that the packaged plugin carries package.json, which the plugin needs because it is an ES module ("type": "module"); without it, every .js file fails to load. Evidence: tools/server-plugin/shardwright-memory/package.test.mjs has no test for it. Target result: one new test in package.test.mjs named exactly "packaged payload carries package.json declaring an ES module", test-only, that fails if the staged or manifest payload lacks package.json or if that package.json does not declare "type": "module"; all existing tests unchanged and passing. In scope: package.test.mjs only; no runtime or packager change. Out of scope: every other file, including AGENTS.md, docs/contracts/, docs/proposals/, tools/slice-runner/, tools/pilot/, vendor/. Outside this repository: nothing. Proof: node tools/pilot/proofs/pilot-3-payload-package-json-test.mjs from the repository root (requires that named test to run and pass, and the whole file to pass). Stop condition: proof passes; report and stop. Do not commit.
